definition: (rural or rustic language) little - a) small in size; b) small in amount, number or degree; not much; c) short in duration or distance; not long; d) small in force, intensity, etc.
example: ಇನ್ನೂ ಒಸಿ ಹಾಲು ಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಮಗು ಕೇಳಿತು.
example_en: The child asked for a little more milk.

definition: one of the six main schools of ancient Indian philosophy.
example: ಆ ವಿದ್ವಾಂಸ ವೇದಾಂತ ತತ್ವಗಳನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡಿದ.
example_en: That scholar studied the principles of Vedanta philosophy deeply.

definition: a bent ear.
example: ಆ ಆಡಿಗೆ ಓರೆಕಿವಿ ಇರುವುದರಿಂದ ಬೇಗ ಗುರುತಿಸಬಹುದು.
example_en: That goat can be easily recognized because it has a bent ear.

definition: anything that is red or has turned red.
example_en: All the leaves of the tree turned red and fell off.

definition: a woman who has completed a course of study in a college and has received a degree; a graduate.
example_en: She is a graduate of the science department.

definition: a land gifted to a person, exempting fifty per cent of the normal tax on it.
example_en: That half-tax-exempt land belonged to the temple.

definition: that is bent.
example: ಹಿರಿಯರ ಮುಂದೆ ಅವನ ತಲೆ ನಮ್ರವಾಗಿ ಬಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: His head was bent humbly before the elders.

definition: anything that is remaining; remainder; balance.
example: ಸಾಲ ತೀರಿಸಿದ ನಂತರ ಉೞಿಕಲ್ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪವೇ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: After repaying the debt, only a little remainder was left.

definition: having magnitude, but not direction in space (as volume or temperature); scalar.
example_en: Temperature is an example of a scalar quantity.

definition: to go under the surface of a liquid.
example_en: The swimmer went under the water and submerged himself.

definition: a thick liquid in which relatively large number of small insoluble particles are in suspension and remain for long without getting settled to the bottom; gel; sol; emulsion.
example_en: The medicine's emulsion was thick at the bottom of the bottle.

definition: the plant Clerodendrum indicum ( = Siphonanthus indica) of Verbenaceae family.
example_en: The barangi plant is used in the preparation of medicine.

definition: a play for amusement or recreation.
example_en: The children engaged in playful recreation in the evening.

definition: a kind of raw salt.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನ ಬಿಡಲವಣವನ್ನು ಮೀನಿನ ಸಂರಕ್ಷಣೆಗೆ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The village people use raw salt for preserving fish.

definition: to tell (something) to (someone) privately and in a very low tone or as a secret; to whisper.
example_en: She whispered secretly to her friend.

definition: the act or an instance of inquiring.
example_en: He made an inquiry to the teacher.

definition: a vertical structure that serves as the main support of the super structure.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಗಟ್ಟಿಯಾದ ಕೀಲ್ಕಂಬ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: They had erected a sturdy central pillar in the middle of the house.

definition: to join two or more things together in an orderly manner.
example_en: The engineer joined the two pipes together.

definition: a species of lemon tree.
example_en: A lemon tree of that species has grown in the backyard.

definition: a healing; restoration to health or a sound condition.
example_en: He recovered quickly with the medicine.

definition: that part of the day from sunset to the next dawn; night.
example_en: The whole village was asleep during the night.

definition: any swimming or wading bird; a water-bird.
example_en: The water-birds returned to their nests in the evening.

definition: to put bring or bring join (different things) together.
example_en: She brought together the ingredients needed for cooking.

definition: the act of tickling.
example: ಮಗು ಪಾದಕ್ಕೆ ಕಚ್ಚಕುಳಿ ಇಟ್ಟಾಗ ಜೋರಾಗಿ ನಕ್ಕಿತು.
example_en: The baby laughed loudly when tickled on the foot.

definition: a vegetable or fruit cooked with spices and seasoned with salt, pepper, etc.
example_en: Mother prepared a spiced cucumber dish.

definition: a short, catchy saying, usu. of unknown origin, that expresses effectively some commonplace truth or useful thought; an adage; a saw; a proverb.
example_en: Grandmother said a good proverb.

definition: a carrying out, managing anything systematically.
example_en: He carried out the work systematically.

definition: the condition or quality of being clean, pure, limpid.
example: ಸರೋವರದ ನೀರಿನ ತಿಳಿಮೆಯನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬೆರಗಾದರು.
example_en: Everyone was amazed at the limpidness of the lake water.

definition: great splendour.
example: ರಾಜನ ಆಸ್ಥಾನದ ಹಿಂಡುಹೊಳಹು ಎಲ್ಲರ ಕಣ್ಣು ಕುಕ್ಕಿತು.
example_en: The great splendour of the king's court dazzled everyone's eyes.

definition: (mus.) in Karnāṭaka system, a musical mode (rāga) derived from the main mode Rasikapriya.
example_en: The singer sang the raga Rasamanjari at the gathering.

definition: to fry (grains on a hot pan).
example_en: Grandmother fried the groundnuts on the pan.

definition: an upper garment of men, having sleeves, and covering from shoulder to the waist.
example_en: He wore the new upper garment with pride.

definition: a fruit that is delicious.
example_en: Delicious fruits have grown abundantly in that garden.

definition: a kind of leprosy.
example: ಆಯುರ್ವೇದ ಗ್ರಂಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಕನಕಕ್ಷೀರಿ ಎಂಬ ಚರ್ಮರೋಗದ ಉಲ್ಲೇಖವಿದೆ.
example_en: The Ayurvedic text mentions a skin disease called kanakakṣīri.

definition: to cause to jump up or over.
example_en: The rider made the horse jump over the fence.

definition: the eleventh of the twenty seven lunar mansions, containing two stars.
example_en: The Purba lunar mansion appeared in the horoscope.

definition: the advancement of darkness, immediately following the sunset.
example_en: In the advancing darkness after sunset, the village lamps lit up one by one.

definition: (usu. in pl.) the feet of a religious teacher, priest or seer.
example_en: The disciples bowed at the feet of the religious teacher.

definition: lack of forethought and caution; foolishness.
example_en: His foolishness caused trouble for everyone.

definition: the quality or fact of being boundless, infinite; boundlessness.
example_en: He was astonished seeing the boundlessness of the ocean.

definition: swiftly; quickly.
example_en: The fire spread swiftly.

definition: the state of being compact, condensed or solidified.
example_en: In winter, the solidifying of oil happens quickly.

definition: to go from one place to another; make a journey or journeys.
example_en: He traveled abroad.

definition: an artful or secret plot or scheme, esp. one with evil intent; an evil design; machinations.
example_en: His evil machinations caused trouble for the organization.

definition: to move (something, esp. a spherical object) forward along a surface by rotation without sliding; to roll.
example_en: The boys rolled a boulder down from the hill.

definition: an account of another (or third) person.
example: ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ನಟನ ಕುರಿತ ಪರಾಖ್ಯಾನ ಪ್ರಕಟವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: An account about that actor was published in the newspaper.

definition: a drawing or being drawn towards.
example_en: She had a drawing pull towards the child.

definition: got up; climbed; ascended.
example: ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ತುದಿಗೆ ರೂಢನಾದ ಮೇಲೆ ಆಯಾಸ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಯಿತು.
example_en: After climbing to the top of the hill, his tiredness reduced.

definition: temptation for or a being tempted by, a bribe.
example_en: That clerk was tempted with a bribe.

definition: the act of capturing or imprisoning.
example_en: The capture of the enemies took place at night.

definition: a male, adult human being; a man.
example_en: That man was working in the field.

definition: a woman of noble descent.
example_en: That noble woman belonged to the royal family.

definition: an efficient physician.
example_en: That efficient physician cured the severe illness.

definition: the largest of the outlets of a water tank.
example_en: The tank's water flowed out through the largest outlet.

definition: not pleasing to look at; ugly; unsightly.
example_en: That statue was broken and looked ugly.

definition: to swing in a sweet tone.
example: ಹಕ್ಕಿಗಳು ಮರದ ಕೊಂಬೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತಿಲ್ಲಾಣಿಸುತ್ತಾ ಮಧುರವಾಗಿ ಹಾಡಿದವು.
example_en: The birds swung on the tree branch and sang in a sweet tone.

definition: a watery discharge from the mucous membranes especially of the eyes; the rheum of the eye.
example_en: The eye was filled with rheum.

definition: that which is saved from being spent; saving.
example_en: I have deposited this month's savings in the bank.

definition: excessively; abundantly.
example_en: The harvest was abundant in that village.

definition: the shrub Coffea arabica of Rubiaceae family; coffee plant.
example_en: The coffee plants in the garden have grown well.

definition: either of the two forelimbs of most birds and of bats that are specialised for flight; the wing.
example_en: The kite's wing frame was broken.

definition: a superior or supreme god.
example_en: The devotees offered prayers to the supreme god.

definition: the fact or quality of being impertinent; lack of pertinence; irrelevance; impertinence.
example_en: Everyone realized the irrelevance of that statement.

definition: the Goddess of Death.
example_en: People worship the Goddess of Death with fear.

definition: a headgear with a slight slant.
example_en: He wore a slightly slanted headgear and went outside.

definition: an oblong, woolen cloth, used as a covering for the head and shoulders for warming purpose; a shawl.
example_en: She wrapped a shawl around herself to protect from the cold.

definition: the news that is current, but not confirmed or authentic; a rumour.
example_en: An unconfirmed rumour spread about the price rise.

definition: occurring or existing in a high degree; very strong; violent, extreme, sharp.
example_en: That night extreme, violent rain poured down.

definition: the tip of a finger.
example_en: The tip of the child's finger got pricked by a thorn.

definition: to oppose defiantly or resistantly.
example_en: The child defiantly resisted taking the medicine.

definition: the outer side, part or surface; outside.
example_en: The children ran outside the house to play.

definition: a feast of meat.
example_en: They had arranged a feast of meat on the festival day.

definition: a staying, camping or lodging at a place.
example_en: The travellers' camping continued for two days.

definition: a vehement desire.
example_en: She had a vehement desire to travel.

definition: that which is not complex, intricate, etc.
example_en: This is a simple task; it will finish easily.

definition: a pledging of a stolen articles.
example: ಕಳ್ಳರು ಕದ್ದ ವಸ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ಕಳ್ಳೊತ್ತೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಹಣ ಪಡೆದರು.
example_en: The thieves pledged the stolen articles and got money.

definition: the hair at the lower part of the abdomen surrounding the external genitals; pubes.
example_en: Pubic hair is a natural body hair.

definition: a false promise.
example_en: His false promise caused her loss.

definition: the state of being completely spoiled, ruined.
example_en: After the war, the town fell into complete ruin.

definition: to bake or cook using steam.
example_en: Grandmother cooked the idli using steam.

definition: a continuing and bitter hate or ill will; deep spite or malice; hostility; enmity.
example_en: The bitter enmity between the two did not lessen even after years.

definition: a wrong statement; a deceiving speech; the act of lying.
example_en: The witness made a false statement in the court.

definition: an occult clan of muslims.
example_en: There was a group of sufis in that town.

definition: (hist.) a British gold coin valued at 20 shillings or one pound sterling; a sovereign.
example_en: Grandmother kept the gold sovereign coin in the box.

definition: the tendency to running.
example_en: Everyone at school grew tired of his tendency to run.

definition: neatness in arrangement; orderliness.
example_en: She had arranged all the items with neatness.

definition: (excess water) to flow out through an outlet.
example_en: The tank filled up and the excess water flowed out through the outlet.

definition: any of various plants of the grass family that are usu. used for food, fodder or grazing and as lawns; grass.
example_en: The cows were grazing on the green grass in the field.

definition: the act of making something ready; preparation.
example_en: The preparation needed for the worship was finished in the morning itself.

definition: a woman of dignified, noble behaviour and manners; she who is not given to flirting.
example_en: That dignified woman conducted herself with respect at the assembly.

definition: an open cell, niche, recess etc.
example_en: An open niche in the wall looked like a brick.

definition: one or a single man.
example_en: That one man finished the entire work.

definition: to have grace, exquisiteness.
example_en: That artwork had great grace and exquisiteness.

definition: a physical fighting, contest in which two opponents grapple and try to throw the other down; wrestling.
example_en: The two wrestlers had a wrestling bout in the arena.

definition: the hair on the body of human beings and animals.
example_en: The hair on the animal's body was soft.

definition: a man whose work is construction of buildings with brick, concrete, etc.; a mason.
example_en: The mason built the wall with bricks.

definition: (mus.) a mode.
example_en: He played the nadottari mode at the concert.

definition: to turn from a direct line or course or from being a straight line.
example_en: Seeing the pit, the cart wheel turned off its straight course.

definition: a light cloth used as a veil.
example_en: She had covered her face with a light cloth veil.

definition: the state or fact of being one with; the quality of being one in spirit, sentiment, with; oneness; unity.
example: ಗುರುಶಿಷ್ಯರ ನಡುವೆ ಒಂದು ಆಳವಾದ ಐಕ್ಯಭಾವ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a deep sense of oneness between the guru and the disciple.

definition: a restraining, compelling or constraining by force; coercion.
example: ಪೊಲೀಸರ ದಬಾದಬಿಗೆ ಒಳಗಾಗಿ ಅವನು ಸಹಿ ಹಾಕಿದನು.
example_en: Subjected to the police's coercion, he signed the paper.

definition: to cause to suck or chew.
example_en: The mother made the child suck on the candy.

definition: a sort of wooden ledge or guard fastened round a chariot as a defence against collision.
example_en: The chariot's guard protected it from collision.

definition: to give a hint of a secret, plot, etc.; to reveal; to divulge.
example_en: He revealed his secret plot to his friend.

definition: defiiteness; the quality of a) having exact limits; b) having definite qualities; c) being precise and clear in meaning; d) being certain.
example_en: Definiteness was evident in his answer.

definition: not having, dealing with, any subject.
example_en: That speech ended without dealing with any subject.

definition: a sprouted seed.
example_en: He sowed the sprouted seed in the soil.

definition: the science of diagnosing, treating, curing, and preventing disease, decay, and preserving soundness of human teeth and jaws; dentistry.
example_en: He went to Bengaluru to study dentistry.

definition: a set or association of two persons, animals or things; a pair.
example_en: She needed a pair of bangles.

definition: a low voice.
example_en: The patient said something in a low voice.

definition: to produce foam.
example_en: When the soapy water was churned, it produced foam.

definition: the disc of the sun (as it appears to us).
example_en: The disc of the sun appeared red in the evening sky.

definition: that which is carried; a load; a burden.
example_en: He carried the burden and reached home.

definition: a man who sifts gold particles from the gold ore.
example: ಜಲಗಾರ ನದಿಯ ಮರಳಿನಿಂದ ಚಿನ್ನದ ಕಣ ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The gold-sifter separated gold particles from the river sand.

definition: (a condition of satisfaction) to come to; to happen.
example_en: After all preparations, the task came to a satisfactory conclusion.

definition: medical or surgical care required for of extended to a sick, injured person.
example_en: The wounded soldier was immediately given medical treatment.

definition: (fig.) stubborn perverseness that can not be corrected.
example: ಅವನ ಕೆಟ್ಟ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ನಾಯಿಬಾಲದಂತೆ, ಎಂದೂ ಸರಿಯಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: His bad habit is like a dog's tail, it never gets corrected.

definition: to make more certain the validity of; to confirm; to corroborate.
example_en: The officer confirmed the report.

definition: a man having the qualities gen. attributed to women, as weakness, timidity, delicacy, etc.; an effeminate.
example_en: The effeminate man is afraid of a fight.

definition: the onset of spring season.
example_en: With the onset of spring, new sprouts appeared on the trees.

definition: Śiva (who is associated with Amba, i.e. Pārvati).
example_en: The devotees worshipped Sāmba with devotion.

definition: a main road; a highway.
example: ಆ ಭಾಟೆಮಾರ್ಗ ಎರಡು ದೊಡ್ಡ ನಗರಗಳನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: That highway connects two big cities.

definition: a variety of wild date palm, akin to sago date palm.
example_en: People were extracting toddy from the wild date palm tree.

definition: the bird Ardea grayii; a maroon backed heron.
example: ಗಕ್ಕು ಮೀನು ಹಿಡಿಯಲು ನದಿಯ ದಡದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಂತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The maroon-backed heron stood on the riverbank to catch fish.

definition: a subtle, often artistic, work.
example_en: He carved a delicate work on the wood.

definition: to pay what is due.
example_en: He paid off the debt, settling what was due.

definition: a kind of animal.
example: ಆ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದಣಿಬೆ ಎಂಬ ಪ್ರಾಣಿ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is an animal called daṇibe in that forest.

definition: the fact or condition of not having teeth.
example: ಮುದುಕನ ಬೋಡಿನಿಂದ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಆಹಾರ ಜಗಿಯಲು ಕಷ್ಟವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Because of the old man's toothlessness, it was hard for him to chew food.

definition: the sacred book of Islam believed to contain revelations made to Mohammed by Allah; Koran.
example_en: A recitation of the Koran took place in the mosque.

definition: a place where tents, huts, barracks or other structures have been put up, as for temporary stay of soldiers; a camp.
example_en: The soldiers set up camp at the border and stayed there.

definition: a man or boy whose work is tending, feeding, and currying horses; a groom.
example: ಆ ಸಾಣಿ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆಯೇ ಕುದುರೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಮೈ ತೊಳೆದನು.
example_en: That groom washed the horses early in the morning.

definition: a lonely man.
example_en: That lonely man sat in the corner of the house.

definition: a man having the mystic power by which he knows the happenings in the past, present and future.
example_en: The sage was a knower of past, present and future, seeing all three times.

definition: the wild cotton shrub.
example_en: Wild cotton shrubs have grown on the hillside.

definition: nearness; proximity.
example_en: The school was in close proximity to the house.

definition: a compelling or being compelled; coercion; constraint; compulsion.
example_en: They silenced him through coercion.

definition: an abscess in the heel or armpit.
example_en: An abscess formed in his heel and he could not walk.

definition: to open the closed fist.
example_en: He slowly opened his fist and showed the coin.

definition: a cord, snare or noose, the weapon of Varuṇa.
example: ಪುರಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ವರುಣಪಾಶ ಎಂಬ ಅಸ್ತ್ರದ ವರ್ಣನೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: The purana describes a weapon called Varuna's noose.

definition: to become numbed physically; to be benumbed.
example_en: Her leg went numb from the sitting posture.

definition: the cardinal number twelve.
example_en: There were twelve eggs in that box.

definition: a military officer.
example_en: The military officer led the army.

definition: to use; to utilise; to put to use.
example_en: This tool can be utilised for farming work.

definition: act of wiping away; cleansing; purification.
example: ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಮೂರ್ತಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ದಿನ ಅಪಮಾರ್ಜನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The temple idol is cleansed and purified every day.

definition: a glass bottle.
example_en: The bottle fell down and broke.

definition: the line where the sky apparently meets the earth; horizon.
example_en: The sun set beyond the horizon.

definition: a red, thick ant.
example_en: Red thick ants swarmed the spot where sugar had spilled.

definition: to keep one above the other or one by the side of the other in a row; to arrange in a stack; to stack.
example_en: He stacked the books one above the other.

definition: an order of reptile, now extinct; ceteosaur.
example_en: The ceteosaur animals became extinct long ago.

definition: a heavy wave (on the surface of a sea).
example_en: The heavy wave struck the fishermen's boat.

definition: completely; entirely.
example_en: He completed the work entirely.

definition: without permission, approval or licence.
example: ಅವನು ಬಗರ್ ಹುಕುಂ ಆ ಜಮೀನನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿದನು.
example_en: He used that land without permission.

definition: a hand-held gun with a short barrel; a small rifle; a revolver.
example_en: He took aim with the revolver.

definition: towards outside.
example_en: The children ran towards outside to play.

definition: to be divided between or among.
example_en: The father's property was divided among the children.

definition: air; wind.
example_en: The wind blew gently on the river bank.

definition: the quality of being destructive, harmful to the society.
example_en: The people condemned his quality of being harmful to society.

definition: a man who has invested capital in a business enterprise; an investor; a capitalist.
example: ಊರಿನ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಭಂಡವಾಳಿಗ ಶಾಲೆಗೆ ದೇಣಿಗೆ ನೀಡಿದನು.
example_en: The town's wealthy capitalist donated to the school.

definition: (a hooded snake) to move the opened hood to the left and right slowly.
example_en: The cobra lay near the anthill slowly swaying its opened hood.

definition: the quality or fact of lasting for long or forever.
example_en: This temple has everlasting fame.

definition: a crown set with a diamond or diamonds.
example_en: The diamond crown adorned the deity's idol.

definition: a man who lacks sophistication, refinement etc.; a stupid, uncouth, uncultured man.
example_en: Everyone laughed at that uncouth man's words.

definition: activity engaged in for amusement or recreation; sport, games, etc.; a play.
example_en: The children ran to the ground for the evening sport.

definition: a device used to write with; a pen.
example_en: The writer wrote with a pen.

definition: a respectful term for or a term of endearment for, addressing an elder sister or an elder woman.
example: ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಮಗು ತನ್ನ ಅಕ್ಕಣಿಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರೀತಿಯಿಂದ ಕರೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The little child fondly called her elder sister akkaṇi.

definition: a fiery eye.
example_en: Everyone ran away seeing the demon's fiery eyes.

definition: any of flowering creepers.
example_en: A flowering creeper had spread over the pergola in the garden.

definition: any of various shrimplike decapod crustaceans of the genera Palaemon, Penaeus, etc., certain of which are used as food; a prawn.
example_en: The fishermen caught a lot of prawns today.

definition: to get knowledge or an awareness of (something) through the eyes; to perceive visually; to look at; to view; to see; to observe.
example_en: He viewed the distant mountain.

definition: plentifully; excessively.
example_en: This year the rain poured excessively.

definition: the quality of being rough, crude or harsh; roughness; harshness.
example_en: Harshness was clearly visible in his behaviour.

definition: a grieving with long pitiful cries.

definition: three or more strands of interwoven hair.
example_en: She tied her hair into an interwoven braid.

definition: a tall spar or, now often, a hollow metal structure, sometimes in sections, rising vertically from the keel or deck of a vessel and used to support the sails, yards, radar and radio equipment, etc.; the mast of a vessel.
example_en: The sailors tightened the mast with ropes.

definition: to become soaked in a liquid (as water, blood, etc.).
example_en: The cloth became soaked in the rain.

definition: farm animals collectively, as domesticated cows, bulls, etc.; cattle.
example_en: The number of cattle is high in this village.

definition: the perennial, composite plant Dahlia variabilis of Asteraceae family; dahlia plant.
example_en: She planted a dahlia plant in a pot.

definition: (pl.) tributes and presentations.
example_en: The subjects presented tributes to the king.

definition: to lay the foundation.
example_en: The workers laid the foundation for the house early in the morning.

definition: of or relating to radius; radial.
example_en: The radial lines of the wheel extend outward from the centre.

definition: the act or an instance of stealing; theft.
example_en: He had a habit of stealing.

definition: to seize (a person) by legal authority or warrant; to take into custody; to arrest.
example_en: The police arrested the thief.

definition: the plant Mucuna prurita ( = M. puriens) of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The adhyaṇḍe creeper has spread along the forest edge.
